entries.def:
ἁφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), [in LXX for נֶגַע, frequently in Le ;] 
a joint (MM, see word): Eph.4.16, Col.2.19 (Lft., in l).†
(AS)

ἀφθαρσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄφθαρτος), [in LXX: Wis.2.23; 6.19, 4Ma.9.22 4Mac.17.12 * ;] 
incorruptibility, immortality: Rom.2.7, 1Co.15.42; 15.50; 15.53-54, 2Ti.1.10; ἀγαπώντων . . . ἐν ἀ., Eph.6.24 (see AR, in l).†
ἀ-φθορία, -ας, ἡ 
(φθείρω), [in LXX: Hag.2.17 (שְׁדֵפָה)* ;] 
uncorruptness: Tit.2.7 (Rec. ἀφθορία).†
(AS)

ἀφ-ίημι, 
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;] 
__1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), 1Co.7.11-13; of death, τ. πνεῦμα (Gen.35.18, Hdt., al.), Mat.27.50 (φωνήν, to utter a cry, Mrk.15.37 of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, Mat.18.27 τ. ὀφειλήν, Mat.18.32 esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, Mat.9.2, Rom.4.7" (LXX),…

ἀφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι 
[in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;] 
perfective of ἱκνέομαι, to come (M, Pr., 247), to arrive at, come to, reach: metaphorically (MM, see word), Rom.16.19.†
(AS)

ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος, -ον 
without love of good: 2Ti.3.3 (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but see MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἀ-φιλ-άργυρος, -ον 
without love of money, not avaricious; 1Ti.3.3, Heb.13.5. (For other instances, see MM, see word)†
(AS)

ἄφ-ιξις, -εως, ἡ 
(ἀφικνέομαι), [in LXX: 3Ma.7.18 * ;] 
in cl. usually, arrival; rarely, departure: Act.20.29 (so in π., cf. MM, see word; M, Pro.26.1-28, n.).†
(AS)

ἀφ-ίστημι 
[in LXX for סוּר, מָעַל, etc. (41 words in all) ;] 
__1. trans. in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put away, lead away; metaphorically, to move to revolt: Act.5.37. 
__2. Intrans. in pf., plpf., 2 aor., to stand off, depart from, withdraw from: with genitive, Luk.2.37 before ἀπό, Luk.4.13; 13.27, Act.5.38; 12.10; 15.38; 19.9; 22.29, 2Co.12.8; metaphorically, ἀπὸ ἀδικίας, 2Ti.2.19 ἀπὸ θεοῦ, (fall away,…

ἄφνω 
adv., [in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם ;] 
suddenly: Act.2.2; 16.26; 28.6.†
(AS)
